# BUBU Studio

> BUBU Studio is the home of drip tufting, the hand-tufting technique invented by German artist Jan Fechner. Melting mountain silhouettes in wool, with colour gradients built thread by thread and bold, poppy colour combinations. Based in Old Paphos, Cyprus. First collection, Liquid Mountains.

Key facts

- Drip tufting is a hand-tufting technique invented by Jan Fechner in 2025/2026 in Cyprus.
- The core of the technique is the granular colour gradient built thread by thread, the colour combinations and the melting drip form. The trimming is only the finish.
- Liquid Mountains is the first drip tufting collection. Its formal vocabulary is Drips, Pools, Stones, Burns and Springs.
- Originals and studies are one of a kind, hand-tufted by Jan Fechner in the Paphos studio, numbered and signed with certificate. Editions are produced with partner workshops in Pakistan and finished and signed in Paphos.
- BUBU Studio was founded in 2025 by Jan Fechner and Alizay in Old Paphos, Cyprus. Studio opening 2026.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bubu_studios
- Press contact: jan@bubu-studio.com
